_說明: 念課文孵寵物的寵物圖（台灣原生動物寶寶，原創）。repo 根目錄執行：python mandarin/tools/gen_cards.py hatch/tools/pets.json；畫完看一遍有沒有字。

cards.name: 台灣藍鵲
cards.scene: A cute chubby round baby version, big shiny eyes, happy, sitting, full body, alone in the center, small soft shadow under it. The animal is a baby Formosan blue magpie chick with bright blue feathers, red beak, red feet and a long blue-and-white tail.
